transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (apps/floor) was deleted on 2026-10-02. The deletion came in PR #2431 (commit ca031776d). The external Floor engine replaced it. This is the rewritten, standalone Floor at re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore. Lore reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`, as set out in ADR-049 and specs/external-floor. The code moved over one family of assembly lines at a time. Afterwards, PR #2454 removed the old line files, the detectors and the fallbacks to the deleted engine.
